scope: Maximum two proposed presentation moments per fiscal year, FY2021–FY2023. Local sources only; no model or network calls.

sources.snapshot_note: Same verified PDF now retained in the collector; initial proposal used a temporary text extraction.

items.title: Board authorizes up to $50B of Class C repurchases
items.interpretation: The board created repurchase capacity; July 2021 amended eligible share classes.
limits: Authorization capacity is not a promise to spend the full amount and cannot be matched to annual cash repurchases.
The July amendment expands eligible share classes; preserve it separately from the original authorization. No individual director contribution or investment-return judgment is established.

evidence.exact_quote:
In July 2021, the
Alphabet board approved an amendment to the April 2021 authorization, permitting the company to repurchase both Class A and Class C shares
In April 2021, the Board of Directors of Alphabet authorized the company to repurchase up to $50.0 billion of its Class C stock.

items.title: FY2021: revenue $257.6B, up 41%
items.interpretation: Reported consolidated revenue outcome; use as business scale/context in the operating-efficiency view, alongside costs and margins.
limits: The report says the adverse effect of COVID-19 on 2020 advertising revenues contributed to the growth comparison. This is a company outcome, not a reviewed promise match or proof of an individual contribution.

evidence.exact_quote:
Revenues were $257.6 billion, an increase of 41%. The increase in revenues was primarily driven by Google Services and Google Cloud.
The adverse effect of COVID-19 on 2020 advertising revenues also contributed to the year-over-year growth.

items.title: Mandiant acquisition closes for $6.1B
items.interpretation: A completed acquisition expanded the Google Cloud business; the report states results enter Cloud from the acquisition date.
limits: Completion and purchase price do not establish realized synergies, investment returns, or fulfillment of an earlier promise.
Acquired activity changes Google Cloud scope; retain acquisition context when comparing segment growth across years. No individual director or executive causation is established.

evidence.exact_quote:
On September 12, 2022, we closed the acquisition of Mandiant for a total purchase price of $6.1 billion and
added more than 2,600 employees. Mandiant's financial results are reported within Google Cloud as of the
acquisition date.

items.title: FY2022: revenue $282.8B, up 10%
items.interpretation: Reported consolidated revenue outcome; use as business scale/context in the operating-efficiency view, alongside costs and margins.
limits: Reported growth and constant-currency growth are distinct measures; the report separately states 14% constant-currency growth excluding hedging. Revenue growth alone does not establish operating efficiency, AI profitability, or director contribution.

evidence.exact_quote:
Revenues were $282.8 billion, an increase of 10% year over year, primarily driven by an increase in Google
Services revenues of $16.0 billion, or 7%, and an increase in Google Cloud revenues of $7.1 billion, or 37%.

items.title: Workforce reduction announced; $2.1B annual severance charges

attribution.decision_by: Company announcement; individual not named in excerpt

items.interpretation: The report dates the workforce-reduction announcement to January and reports severance costs for the full year separately.
limits: The quoted passage supplies neither an exact January day nor a 12,000-person figure; do not infer either.
The $2.1B charge is a full-year amount, not a January cash payment. Workforce reduction and severance expense do not demonstrate savings, improved efficiency, or individual contribution.

evidence.exact_quote:
In January 2023, we announced a reduction of our workforce, and as a result we recorded employee severance and
related charges of $2.1 billion for the year ended December 31, 2023.

items.title: FY2023: revenue $307.4B, up 9%
items.interpretation: Reported consolidated revenue outcome; use as business scale/context in the operating-efficiency view, alongside costs and margins.
limits: Revenue growth alone does not establish promise delivery, AI profitability, or an individual contribution. Any margin comparison must retain the change in server/network useful lives: the report states $3.9B lower FY2023 depreciation expense on physical page 42.

evidence.exact_quote:
Revenues were $307.4 billion, an increase of 9% year over year, primarily driven by an increase in Google Services
revenues of $19.0 billion, or 8%, and an increase in Google Cloud revenues of $6.8 billion, or 26%.

global_limits: Annual outcomes are measurement periods, never point events. Statement dates and first-disclosure dates remain unknown here unless supported separately.
Exact quotation presence is a provenance check, not approval of interpretation. Saved extraction references, where present, do not establish pipeline acceptance.
These items support contextual presentation only; no personal honesty score, universal score, or inferred individual causation.
